text: This candidate received an overall score of 0.26 for the Senior Software Engineer position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications is their computer science degree and listed experience with "Node.js" and "AWS". Key gaps include a lack of experience with python, vue.js, and react, as well as having only 2.5 years of experience compared to the implied 4-year requirement. The application was escalated for manual review despite the missing must-have skills and low overall fit.
